SUBSTITUTE TYPE 1 ZONING AMENDMENT PROJECT
NARRATIVE AND PLANS
950 W. Willow Street

The Applicant seeks to rezone 950 W. Willow Street from RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse
and Multi-Unit District to a RM-5 Residential Multi-Unit District to construct a new four-story
multifamily residential building containing four dwelling units with rooftop deck and three
parking spaces. The lot is currently improved with a three-story multifamily residential building

with four (4) dwelling units. The building's zoning height will be 42 feet. No commercial space
will be provided.

Pursuant to Section 17-13-0303-D, the Applicant seeks to reduce the following setbacks: (1) to
reduce the required front setback to 0 feet and (2) to reduce the required rear setback to 30 feet,
11 inches under Section 17-13-1101-B. The Applicant seeks an administrative adjustment to
increase the parking spaces from 2 to 3 under Section 17-13-1003-EE. The Applicant also requests

all zoning relief required under the Chicago Zoning Ordinance necessary for the plans subject to
this Zoning Map Amendment.
